canDoYue: 你識用餐時添水、要餐巾，仲識讚好味。
canDoEn: Ask for a refill or a napkin during the meal, and say the food is delicious.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Are you enjoying the meal? I can bring a refill.
dialogue.glossYue: 你食得開唔開心？我可以幫你添一杯。
dialogue.say: Are you enjoying the meal? I can bring a refill.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: Could we get still water and one napkin for this fork?
dialogue.glossYue: 可唔可以嚟杯冇氣水，同埋一張餐巾畀呢支叉？
dialogue.say: Could we get still water and one napkin for this fork?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Here is the still water. The napkin is by your knife.
dialogue.glossYue: 冇氣水喺度。餐巾喺你把刀旁邊。
dialogue.say: Here is the still water. The napkin is by your knife.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: This fish is delicious, and I would like more sparkling water.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢條魚好味，我想要多啲有氣水。
dialogue.say: This fish is delicious, and I would like more sparkling water.

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the fish.
dialogue.glossYue: 有氣水就到，希望你可以慢慢食條魚。
dialogue.say: The sparkling water is coming, and I hope you enjoy the fish.

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: No dessert for me. Could we get the bill later?
dialogue.glossYue: 我唔要甜品。可唔可以遲啲先要單？
dialogue.say: No dessert for me. Could we get the bill later?

dialogue.speaker: ana
dialogue.text: Of course. Would you like anything else before you head off?
dialogue.glossYue: 當然可以。你走之前仲想唔想要其他嘢？
dialogue.say: Of course. Would you like anything else before you head off?

dialogue.speaker: tom
dialogue.text: The meal was delicious, and coffee later would be perfect.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢餐好味，遲啲嚟杯咖啡就啱。
dialogue.say: The meal was delicious, and coffee later would be perfect.

understand.prompt: Could we get a refill? 即係問緊咩？
still water 同 sparkling water 差喺？
understand.explain: still 係冇氣，sparkling 係有氣。

understand.prompt: This is delicious. 呢句即係點？

chunks.pattern: Could we get a cold ___ of water before the meal continues?
chunks.example: Could we get a cold refill of water before the meal continues?
chunks.glossYue: 用餐未完，可唔可以再添一杯凍⋯⋯？

chunks.pattern: This fish is ___, and I would like a little more water.
chunks.example: This fish is delicious, and I would like a little more water.

chunks.pattern: Could we get one more clean ___ for this fork please?
chunks.example: Could we get one more clean napkin for this fork please?
chunks.glossYue: 可唔可以多要一張乾淨⋯⋯畀呢支叉？

chunks.pattern: The ___ water is not fizzy, and it is already on the table.
chunks.example: The still water is not fizzy, and it is already on the table.

quiz.prompt: 聽一次，揀你聽到嘅字：碟旁邊嗰塊布
聽一次，揀你聽到嘅字：客人覺得魚好食
客人講「Could we get still water and one napkin for this fork?」呢句入面，邊個意思先啱？
客人講「Are you enjoying the meal? I can bring a refill.」，係咩意思？

quiz.explain: delicious 中間有 /l/。napkin 同 fork 冇。

sound.title: 好味中間嗰個音
sound.note: delicious 中間係 /l/。舌尖抵住上顎後面。napkin 開頭係 /n/。fork 開頭係 /f/。
